installTitle: Add LinkSwiss to your Home Screen
installDesc: Open the app from an icon so you don't lose the link.
installIosHint:
1. Tap Share (the square with the arrow, at the bottom).
2. Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
3. Tap Add.
installAndroidHint:
1. Tap the three dots ⋮ at the top right.
2. Choose Add to Home screen or Install app.
3. Confirm.
installAndroidFirefoxHint:
1. Tap the three dots ⋮.
2. Choose Install or Add to Home screen.
installDesktopHint:
1. To the right of the address, look for a + or a small monitor icon.
2. If it is missing: menu ⋮ (or the three lines) → Install LinkSwiss.
3. Confirm.
installDesktopFirefoxHint:
Firefox on a PC cannot create an app icon.
1. Click the star to the right of the address to save the link.
2. Or press Ctrl+D.
For an icon on the desktop or taskbar, open linkswiss.ch in Chrome or Edge and choose Install.
installDesktopSafariHint:
1. File menu → Add to Dock…
Or drag the page icon to the Dock.
